subject: Bump CMake to 3.10.0 to fix build error on Ubuntu-24 (#1908)
reason: The change only raises cmake_minimum_required in deps/hiredis/CMakeLists.txt from 3.0.0 to 3.10.0 to fix a build error on Ubuntu 24. It is a build-system-only change with no effect on server behaviour, commands, replication, persistence, or tools at runtime, so there is nothing for a fuzzer scenario to exercise.
